title: Tyson and the Three Silly Wishes
description: A plush monkey, three wishes, and one very big mess.
subtitle: A comic adventure about a mountain of donuts, super-speed, and the best wish of all. Loosely after “The Monkey’s Paw,” retold as a silly comic.

cover.alt: Comic cover page: on a rainy morning at the lake cottage, Tyson — spiky light-brown hair, gap-tooth grin, blue plaid shirt — looks bored, until Dad points him to the treasure trunk.

blocks.alt: Comic page 1 of 12: On a rainy morning at the lake cottage, Tyson looks bored, pokes at a bowl of oatmeal, and hears about a treasure trunk on the porch.
blocks.caption: Page 1 of 12 — A Very Boring Morning

blocks.html:
ONE MORNING, AT THE COTTAGE...
Tyson: “BORING.”
Tyson: “OATMEAL AGAIN?”
PLOP
Shane: “I LIKE IT.”
Tyson: “YOU WOULD.”
Dad: “GO CHECK THE TREASURE TRUNK.”
Tyson: “TREASURE?!”

blocks.alt: Comic page 2 of 12: Tyson and Shane creak open an old wooden treasure trunk on the porch and find a pirate hat, a wooden sword, and a rubber duck — and something hidden in the corner.
blocks.caption: Page 2 of 12 — The Treasure Trunk

blocks.html:
CREEEEAK!
Tyson: “ARR, TREASURE!”
SQUEAK!
Shane: “JUST OLD TOYS.”
Tyson: “WAIT. WHAT IS THAT?”

blocks.alt: Comic page 3 of 12: Tyson pulls a cute fuzzy plush monkey from the trunk. Its tag reads: 3 WISHES. BE CAREFUL! Then the monkey winks.
blocks.caption: Page 3 of 12 — Three Wishes?!

blocks.html:
3 WISHES. BE CAREFUL!
Tyson: “THREE WISHES?!”
Shane: “IT SAYS BE CAREFUL.”
GASP!
Tyson: “IT WINKED!”

blocks.alt: Comic page 4 of 12: Tyson wishes for a mountain of donuts. One donut lands on his head — then donuts fill the sky over the porch.
blocks.caption: Page 4 of 12 — Wish Number One

blocks.html:
Tyson: “I WISH FOR...”
Tyson: “...A MOUNTAIN OF DONUTS!”
POOF!
BONK.
Tyson: “THAT'S IT?”
Tyson: “IT WORKS!!!”
PLOP! PLOP! PLOP!

blocks.alt: Comic page 5 of 12: Donuts fill the kitchen. Tyson climbs the pile, crowns himself King of Donuts, takes a giant bite, and watches the pile start to wobble and roll out the door.
blocks.caption: Page 5 of 12 — Donut Mountain

blocks.html:
SOON...
Tyson: “BEST DAY EVER!”
Tyson: “KING OF DONUTS!”
CHOMP!
Tyson: “OKAY. MAYBE... TOO MANY.”
RUMBLE...
Tyson: “UH-OH.”

blocks.alt: Comic page 6 of 12: Dad and Mom open the kitchen door and donuts avalanche out. Shane surfs the wave laughing while Dad stands knee-deep with a donut on his head.
blocks.caption: Page 6 of 12 — The Family Finds Out

blocks.html:
Dad: “TYSON?!?”
Mom: “OH MY.”
WHOOOSH!
Shane: “WHEEE!”
Dad: “HOW MANY DONUTS?”
Tyson: “A MOUNTAIN.”
Tyson: “I CAN FIX THIS.”

blocks.alt: Comic page 7 of 12: Tyson wishes to be super fast and zooms around the kitchen stacking donuts into a huge neat tower. The tower wobbles.
blocks.caption: Page 7 of 12 — Wish Number Two

blocks.html:
Tyson: “I WISH I WAS...”
Tyson: “...SUPER FAST!”
POOF!
ZOOM! STACK! STACK!
Tyson: “DONE! EASY!”
UH-OH...

blocks.alt: Comic page 8 of 12, Flip-O-Rama page A: In four panels with the same yard framing, Tyson runs in a circle by the lake cottage, faster and faster, and cannot stop.
blocks.caption: Page 8 of 12 — Flip-O-Rama (Page A)

blocks.html:
Tyson: “CAN'T... STOP...!”
WHIZ!
BOING! BOING!
Dad: “TYSON?”
WHIRRR!
Tyson: “TOO FAST!!!”
WHOOSH!

scenes.title: Page 9 — Flip-O-Rama (Page B) / The Big Realization

blocks.alt: Comic page 9 of 12, Flip-O-Rama page B: Tyson flips through the air and lands in a soft pile of donuts. Quietly, he realizes wishes make bigger messes, and thinks of his family cleaning up together.
blocks.caption: Page 9 of 12 — Flip-O-Rama (Page B) / The Big Realization

blocks.html:
WHOA-OA-OA!
SPLAT!
Tyson: “WHEW.”
Tyson: “WISHES MAKE BIGGER MESSES.”
Tyson: “I KNOW MY LAST WISH.”

blocks.alt: Comic page 10 of 12: Tyson holds the plush monkey gently and makes his last wish — things back to normal, and they fix it together. Sparkles fly and the donut mountain shrinks.
blocks.caption: Page 10 of 12 — Wish Number Three

blocks.html:
Tyson: “LAST WISH.”
Tyson: “I WISH THINGS WERE NORMAL...”
Tyson: “...AND WE FIX IT TOGETHER!”
POOF!
Tyson: “WHOA.”

blocks.alt: Comic page 11 of 12: Only one tidy box of twelve donuts is left. The whole family cleans up the last sprinkles together, shares the donuts, and Tyson tucks the monkey back into the trunk with a new tag: USE WISHES WISELY.
blocks.caption: Page 11 of 12 — Just Right

blocks.html:
Shane: “ONLY TWELVE?”
Tyson: “JUST RIGHT.”
Dad: “BEST WISH YET.”
USE WISHES WISELY.
Tyson: “THANKS, MONKEY.”

scenes.title: Page 12 — The End... Or Is It?

blocks.alt: Comic page 12 of 12: At sunset the family sits together on the porch, happy and full. Then Shane tiptoes to the trunk, wishes for one donut, and it plops onto his head while Tyson laughs in the doorway.
blocks.caption: Page 12 of 12 — The End... Or Is It?

blocks.html:
THE END!
Shane: “JUST ONE LITTLE WISH...”
Shane: “I WISH FOR ONE DONUT.”
POOF!
BONK!
Tyson: “SHANE!!!”
OR IS IT...?

discussionHtml:
💭 Bedtime Chat

If you had three wishes, what would you wish for — and what silly mess might it make?

🐵 Be Careful What You Wish For Tyson wished for a mountain of donuts and got exactly that — a mountain! Wishes can come true in bigger ways than we expect.
🤝 Together Beats Fast Super-speed only made a bigger mess. Tyson's best wish was the one that let the whole family fix things together.
